en.h1: What Does OE Mean on a Samsung Washing Machine?
en.description: Samsung identifies OE or OF as an overflow condition.
en.quick_fix: Stop the cycle, turn off the water tap and power, and do not run another cycle if water continues entering or leaks (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Samsung identifies OE or OF as an overflow condition.

Stop the cycle, turn off the water tap and power, and do not run another cycle if water continues entering or leaks. Open no panels, measure no internal parts and do not order a part from the symptom alone.

causes_json.cause: Internal inlet valve, level sensor or control fault
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

steps_json.detail: Stop the programme, wait for the drum to stop and do not force the door.
Photograph the display and note the model number, programme stage and visible symptoms.
Stop the cycle, turn off the water tap and power, and do not run another cycle if water continues entering or leaks. Follow the exact manual when draining water or cleaning a filter.
Test only after correcting an external cause, and never with leakage, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or electrical damage.
Request service if the fault remains or returns. Dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Samsung service if the problem remains after safe external checks. Sensors, motors, fans, pumps, valves, wiring and electronics are not user repairs.

Unplug immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load and detergent instructions, keep the washer level and inspect visible hoses and user-accessible filters as the exact manual specifies.

Internal sensor, motor, pump, fan, valve and electronics faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using the washer when OE appears?
faq_json.answer: Stop the cycle, turn off the water tap and power, and do not run another cycle if water continues entering or leaks. Do not continue if the problem remains or there is leakage, burning smell, smoke or abnormal heat.

faq_json.question: Is switching off a repair?
faq_json.answer: No. One restart may check a temporary condition but does not prove that a recurring fault is repaired.

faq_json.question: Does the symptom identify a replacement part?
faq_json.answer: No. Samsung or a qualified technician must diagnose internal parts before anything is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why is the model number required?
faq_json.answer: Code meanings, filter access and safe user steps can differ between Samsung models and markets.

faq_json.question: May I measure internal parts myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure sensors, motors, heaters, pumps, valves, wiring or electronics.

en.h1: Samsung Washing Machine Won't Spin: Safe Checks
en.description: A Samsung washer may not spin because the load is unbalanced, it cannot drain, the installation is unstable or service is required.
en.quick_fix: Redistribute the load, verify that the washer is level and check the external drain path before trying one spin cycle (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
A Samsung washer may not spin because the load is unbalanced, it cannot drain, the installation is unstable or service is required.

Redistribute the load, verify that the washer is level and check the external drain path before trying one spin cycle. Open no panels, measure no internal parts and do not order a part from the symptom alone.

causes_json.cause: Washer is not level or stable
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine internal faults.

steps_json.detail: Stop the programme, wait for the drum to stop and do not force the door.
Photograph the display and note the model number, programme stage and visible symptoms.
Redistribute the load, verify that the washer is level and check the external drain path before trying one spin cycle. Follow the exact manual when draining water or cleaning a filter.
Test only after correcting an external cause, and never with leakage, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or electrical damage.
Request service if the fault remains or returns. Dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Samsung service if the problem remains after safe external checks. Sensors, motors, fans, pumps, valves, wiring and electronics are not user repairs.

Unplug immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load and detergent instructions, keep the washer level and inspect visible hoses and user-accessible filters as the exact manual specifies.

Internal sensor, motor, pump, fan, valve and electronics faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I use the washer when it won't spin?
faq_json.answer: Redistribute the load, verify that the washer is level and check the external drain path before trying one spin cycle. Do not continue if the problem remains or there is leakage, burning smell, smoke or abnormal heat.

faq_json.question: Is switching off a repair?
faq_json.answer: No. One restart may check a temporary condition but does not prove that a recurring fault is repaired.

faq_json.question: Does the symptom identify a replacement part?
faq_json.answer: No. Samsung or a qualified technician must diagnose internal parts before anything is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why is the model number required?
faq_json.answer: Code meanings, filter access and safe user steps can differ between Samsung models and markets.

faq_json.question: May I measure internal parts myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure sensors, motors, heaters, pumps, valves, wiring or electronics.

sv.meta_description: Samsung-tvättmaskinen centrifugerar inte? Kontrollera last, nivå och tömning säkert och se när service krävs.
sv.description: En Samsung-tvättmaskin kan avstå från centrifugering på grund av obalans, utebliven tömning, instabil installation eller ett fel som kräver service.
sv.quick_fix: Fördela tvätten jämnt, kontrollera att maskinen står plant och kontrollera den yttre avloppsvägen innan ett centrifugeringsförsök (cirka 5–30 minuter).
sv.intro_html:
En Samsung-tvättmaskin kan avstå från centrifugering på grund av obalans, utebliven tömning, instabil installation eller ett fel som kräver service.

Fördela tvätten jämnt, kontrollera att maskinen står plant och kontrollera den yttre avloppsvägen innan ett centrifugeringsförsök. Öppna inga paneler, mät inga interna delar och beställ inte en reservdel från symtomet ensam.

causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

causes_json.cause: Maskinen står inte plant eller stabilt
causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

causes_json.cause: Fel i motor, sensor eller styrning
causes_json.detail: Detta är en möjlig orsak; exakt modellmanual och professionell diagnos avgör interna fel.

steps_json.detail: Stoppa programmet, vänta tills trumman står stilla och tvinga inte luckan.
Fotografera displayen och anteckna modellnummer, programfas och synliga symptom.
Fördela tvätten jämnt, kontrollera att maskinen står plant och kontrollera den yttre avloppsvägen innan ett centrifugeringsförsök. Följ exakt manual vid tömning av vatten eller rengöring av filter.
Testa endast efter korrigerad yttre orsak och aldrig vid läckage, bränd lukt, rök, onormal värme eller elskada.
Boka service om felet kvarstår eller återkommer. Demontera inget och gör inga elektriska mätningar.

sv.when_to_call_technician_html:
Boka Samsung-service om problemet kvarstår efter säkra yttre kontroller. Sensorer, motorer, fläktar, pumpar, ventiler, kablage och elektronik är inte användarreparationer.

Koppla ur direkt vid läckage nära el, bränd lukt, rök, gnistor, onormal värme eller utlöst elskydd.
sv.prevention_html:
Följ last- och doseringsanvisningar, håll maskinen plan och kontrollera synliga slangar och användaråtkomliga filter enligt exakt manual.

Interna sensor-, motor-, pump-, fläkt-, ventil- och elektronikfel kan inte förebyggas genom demontering.

faq_json.question: Kan jag använda maskinen när den inte centrifugerar?
faq_json.answer: Fördela tvätten jämnt, kontrollera att maskinen står plant och kontrollera den yttre avloppsvägen innan ett centrifugeringsförsök. Kör inte vidare om problemet kvarstår eller om det finns läckage, bränd lukt, rök eller onormal värme.

faq_json.question: Är en avstängning en reparation?
faq_json.answer: Nej. En enda omstart kan kontrollera ett tillfälligt tillstånd men bevisar inte att ett återkommande fel är löst.

faq_json.question: Visar symtomet vilken reservdel som ska bytas?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Samsung eller en kvalificerad tekniker måste diagnostisera interna delar innan något beställs.

faq_json.question: Varför behövs modellnumret?
faq_json.answer: Kodbetydelser, filteråtkomst och säkra användarsteg kan skilja mellan Samsung-modeller och marknader.

faq_json.question: Får jag mäta interna delar själv?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Ta inte bort paneler och mät inte sensorer, motorer, värmare, pumpar, ventiler, kablage eller elektronik.
